mapper.sql: task_id, project_id, assignee_id, task_name, description, status, due_date, submit_title, submit_content, submit_file, reject_reason, submitted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( project_id, assignee_id, task_name, description, status, due_date ) VALUES ( #{project_id}, #{assignee_id}, #{task_name}, #{description}, 'ONGOING', #{due_date} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM task WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND NOT (status = 'DONE' AND task_name = '최종 결과물') ORDER BY due_date ASC, task_id DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE task
SET submit_title = #{submit_title}, submit_content = #{submit_content}, submit_file = COALESCE(#{submit_file}, submit_file), status = 'REVIEW', submitted_at = NOW(), reject_reason = NULL
WHERE task_id = #{task_id} AND project_id = #{project_id} AND assignee_id = #{assignee_id} AND status = 'ONGOING'
UPDATE task SET status = 'APPROVED', reject_reason = NULL WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND task_id = #{task_id} AND status = 'REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT task.task_id, task.project_id, task.assignee_id, task.task_name, task.description, task.status, task.due_date, task.submit_title, task.submit_content, task.submit_file, task.reject_reason, task.submitted_at, project.title AS project_title FROM task JOIN project ON task.project_id = project.project_id WHERE task.assignee_id = #{assignee_id} AND task.status NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'DONE') AND task.due_date BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY task.due_date ASC, task.task_id DESC

SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, m.name AS assigneeName, t.task_name AS taskName, t.due_date AS dueDate, t.status FROM task t INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.project_id = #{project_id} AND NOT (t.status = 'DONE' AND t.task_name = '최종 결과물') AND t.status != 'APPROVED' ORDER BY CASE t.status WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN 0 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.due_date ASC, t.task_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND NOT (status = 'DONE' AND task_name = '최종 결과물')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND status = 'DONE' AND task_name = '최종 결과물'

SELECT
FROM task WHERE project_id = #{project_id} AND status = 'DONE' AND task_name = '최종 결과물' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, task_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( project_id, assignee_id, task_name, description, status, due_date, submit_title, submit_content, submit_file, reject_reason, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{project_id}, #{assignee_id}, '최종 결과물', NULL, 'DONE', CURRENT_DATE, #{submit_title}, #{submit_content}, #{submit_file}, NULL, NOW() )
